title: Cartoon Bounce lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Cartoon Bounce templates were built and verified in: rigged walk cycle, rigged map pin drop, thought bubble (rigged cloud), squash-and-stretch logo reveal on real parabolas, rigged swinging price tag, rigged boing arrow, comic POW and kids' lesson title card.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 cartoon template, a walk rig with planted feet, or a real arc (parabola baked every 2 f, rotation about a pivot) before using it, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.
parameters: text content (sample copy: names, prices and places are invented)
walk: leg length, swing angle, step frames (regenerate; the stride follows)
logo: the word and its size (the lockup is centred from the measured word width)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The map is a shape stand-in.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (cwk_, cmp_, ctb_, clr_, cpt_, cba_, cpw_, clt_).
Rigs: children are parented (parentId) to a visible pivot with a centred anchor (Shorts, Pin tip, Cloud, Nail, Arrow tail); their stored positions are offsets from the comp centre.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/cartoon_bounce_lab3.py writes the comps; every move is baked as keys (no presets, no masks); open with edit.open {force:true}, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings (notes: speed_jump on impacts and the walk start, repeated_key_value on held keys; intended).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
